lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਖੁ ਮਾਇਆ ਚਿਤੁ ਮੋਹਿਆ ਭਾਈ ਚਤੁਰਾਈ ਪਤਿ ਖੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: bikh maaiaa chit mohiaa bhaaee chaturaaee pat khoi ||
lines.translation: The poisonous Maya has enticed the consciousness, O Siblings of Destiny; through clever tricks, one loses his honor.

lines.gurmukhi: ਚਿਤ ਮਹਿ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਸਚਿ ਵਸੈ ਭਾਈ ਜੇ ਗੁਰ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਸਮੋਇ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: chit mahi thaakur sach vasai bhaaee je gur giaan samoi ||2||
lines.translation: The True Lord and Master abides in the consciousness, O Siblings of Destiny, if the Guru's spiritual wisdom permeates it. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਰੂੜੌ ਰੂੜੌ ਆਖੀਐ ਭਾਈ ਰੂੜੌ ਲਾਲ ਚਲੂਲੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: rooRau rooRau aakheeai bhaaee rooRau laal chalool ||
lines.translation: Beautiful, beautiful, the Lord is called, O Siblings of Destiny; beautiful, like the deep crimson color of the poppy.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੇ ਮਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਬੈਰਾਗੀਐ ਭਾਈ ਦਰਿ ਘਰਿ ਸਾਚੁ ਅਭੂਲੁ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: je man har siu bairaageeai bhaaee dar ghar saach abhool ||3||
lines.translation: If man loves the Lord with detachment, O Siblings of Destiny, he is judged to be true and infallible in the Lord's court and home. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਾਤਾਲੀ ਆਕਾਸਿ ਤੂ ਭਾਈ ਘਰਿ ਘਰਿ ਤੂ ਗੁਣ ਗਿਆਨੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: paataalee aakaas too bhaaee ghar ghar too gun giaan ||
lines.translation: You are pervading the realms of the underworld and the heavenly skies; Your wisdom and glories are in each and every heart.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਭਾਈ ਚੂਕਾ ਮਨਹੁ ਗੁਮਾਨੁ ॥੪॥
lines.transliteration: gur miliai sukh paaiaa bhaaee chookaa manahu gumaan ||4||
lines.translation: Meeting with the Guru, one finds peace, O Siblings of Destiny, and pride is dispelled from the mind. ||4||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਲਿ ਮਲਿ ਕਾਇਆ ਮਾਜੀਐ ਭਾਈ ਭੀ ਮੈਲਾ ਤਨੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: jal mal kaaiaa maajeeai bhaaee bhee mailaa tan hoi ||
lines.translation: Scrubbing with water, the body can be cleaned, O Siblings of Destiny, but the body becomes dirty again.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗਿਆਨਿ ਮਹਾ ਰਸਿ ਨਾਈਐ ਭਾਈ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਹੋਇ ॥੫॥
lines.transliteration: giaan mahaa ras naaeeai bhaaee man tan niramal hoi ||5||
lines.translation: Bathing in the supreme essence of spiritual wisdom, O Siblings of Destiny, the mind and body become pure. ||5||

lines.gurmukhi: ਦੇਵੀ ਦੇਵਾ ਪੂਜੀਐ ਭਾਈ ਕਿਆ ਮਾਗਉ ਕਿਆ ਦੇਹਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: devee devaa poojeeai bhaaee kiaa maagau kiaa dehi ||
lines.translation: Why worship gods and goddesses, O Siblings of Destiny? What can we ask of them? What can they give us?

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਾਹਣੁ ਨੀਰਿ ਪਖਾਲੀਐ ਭਾਈ ਜਲ ਮਹਿ ਬੂਡਹਿ ਤੇਹਿ ॥੬॥
lines.transliteration: paahan neer pakhaaleeai bhaaee jal mahi boodahi tehi ||6||
lines.translation: The stone gods are washed with water, O Siblings of Destiny, but they just sink in the water. ||6||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਬਿਨੁ ਅਲਖੁ ਨ ਲਖੀਐ ਭਾਈ ਜਗੁ ਬੂਡੈ ਪਤਿ ਖੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur bin alakh na lakheeai bhaaee jag boodai pat khoi ||
lines.translation: Without the Guru, the unseen Lord cannot be seen, O Siblings of Destiny; the world is drowning, having lost its honor.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੇ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਹਾਥਿ ਵਡਾਈਆ ਭਾਈ ਜੈ ਭਾਵੈ ਤੈ ਦੇਇ ॥੭॥
lines.transliteration: mere thaakur haath vadaaeeaa bhaaee jai bhaavai tai dei ||7||
lines.translation: Greatness is in the hands of my Lord and Master, O Siblings of Destiny; as He is pleased, He gives. ||7||

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਈਅਰਿ ਬੋਲੈ ਮੀਠੁਲੀ ਭਾਈ ਸਾਚੁ ਕਹੈ ਪਿਰ ਭਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: baeear bolai meethulee bhaaee saach kahai pir bhaai ||
lines.translation: That soul-bride, who talks sweetly and speaks the Truth, O Siblings of Destiny, becomes pleasing to her Husband Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਰਹੈ ਬੇਧੀ ਸਚਿ ਵਸੀ ਭਾਈ ਅਧਿਕ ਰਹੀ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਇ ॥੮॥
lines.transliteration: birahai bedhee sach vasee bhaaee adhik rahee har naai ||8||
lines.translation: Pierced by His Love, she abides in Truth, O Siblings of Destiny, deeply imbued with the Lord's Name. ||8||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਭੁ ਕੋ ਆਖੈ ਆਪਣਾ ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਬੁਝੈ ਸੁਜਾਨੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: sabh ko aakhai aapanaa bhaaee gur te bujhai sujaan ||
lines.translation: Everyone calls God his own, O Siblings of Destiny, but the all-knowing Lord is known only through the Guru.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਬੀਧੇ ਸੇ ਊਬਰੇ ਭਾਈ ਸਬਦੁ ਸਚਾ ਨੀਸਾਨੁ ॥੯॥
lines.transliteration: jo beedhe se oobare bhaaee sabad sachaa neesaan ||9||
lines.translation: Those who are pierced by His Love are saved, O Siblings of Destiny; they bear the Insignia of the True Word of the Shabad. ||9||

lines.gurmukhi: ਈਧਨੁ ਅਧਿਕ ਸਕੇਲੀਐ ਭਾਈ ਪਾਵਕੁ ਰੰਚਕ ਪਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: eedhan adhik sakeleeai bhaaee paavak ra(n)chak paai ||
lines.translation: A large pile of firewood, O Siblings of Destiny, will burn if a small fire is applied.

lines.gurmukhi: ਖਿਨੁ ਪਲੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਿਦੈ ਵਸੈ ਭਾਈ ਨਾਨਕ ਮਿਲਣੁ ਸੁਭਾਇ ॥੧੦॥੪॥
lines.transliteration: khin pal naam ridai vasai bhaaee naanak milan subhaai ||10||4||
lines.translation: In the same way, if the Naam, the Name of the Lord, dwells in the heart for a moment, even for an instant, O Siblings of Destiny, then one meets the Lord with ease, O Nanak. ||10||4||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ਘਰੁ ੧ ਤਿਤੁਕੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: sorath mahalaa 3 ghar 1 titukee ||
lines.translation: Sorat'h, Third Mehl, First House, Thi-Thukay:

lines.gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
lines.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

lines.gurmukhi: ਭਗਤਾ ਦੀ ਸਦਾ ਤੂ ਰਖਦਾ ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਧੁਰਿ ਤੂ ਰਖਦਾ ਆਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: bhagataa dee sadaa too rakhadaa har jeeu dhur too rakhadaa aaiaa ||
lines.translation: You always preserve the honor of Your devotees, O Dear Lord; You have protected them from the very beginning of time.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਹਿਲਾਦ ਜਨ ਤੁਧੁ ਰਾਖਿ ਲਏ ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਹਰਣਾਖਸੁ ਮਾਰਿ ਪਚਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: prahilaad jan tudh raakh lae har jeeu haranaakhas maar pachaaiaa ||
lines.translation: You protected Your servant Prahlaad, O Dear Lord, and annihilated Harnaakhash.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਾ ਨੋ ਪਰਤੀਤਿ ਹੈ ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਮਨਮੁਖ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: guramukhaa no parateet hai har jeeu manamukh bharam bhulaaiaa ||1||
lines.translation: The Gurmukhs place their faith in the Dear Lord, but the self-willed manmukhs are deluded by doubt. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਜੀ ਏਹ ਤੇਰੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: har jee eh teree vadiaaee ||
lines.translation: O Dear Lord, this is Your Glory.

lines.gurmukhi: ਭਗਤਾ ਕੀ ਪੈਜ ਰਖੁ ਤੂ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਭਗਤ ਤੇਰੀ ਸਰਣਾਈ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: bhagataa kee paij rakh too suaamee bhagat teree saranaaee || rahaau ||
lines.translation: You preserve the honor of Your devotees, O Lord Master; Your devotees seek Your Sanctuary. ||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਭਗਤਾ ਨੋ ਜਮੁ ਜੋਹਿ ਨ ਸਾਕੈ ਕਾਲੁ ਨ ਨੇੜੈ ਜਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: bhagataa no jam johi na saakai kaal na neRai jaaee ||
lines.translation: The Messenger of Death cannot touch Your devotees; death cannot even approach them.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕੇਵਲ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਨਿ ਵਸਿਆ ਨਾਮੇ ਹੀ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਪਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: keval raam naam man vasiaa naame hee mukat paaee ||
lines.translation: The Name of the Lord alone abides in their minds; through the Naam, the Name of the Lord, they find liberation.

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਿਧਿ ਸਿਧਿ ਸਭ ਭਗਤਾ ਚਰਣੀ ਲਾਗੀ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਈ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: ridh sidh sabh bhagataa charanee laagee gur kai sahaj subhaaee ||2||
lines.translation: Wealth and all the spiritual powers of the Siddhis fall at the feet of the Lord's devotees; they obtain peace and poise from the Guru. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖਾ ਨੋ ਪਰਤੀਤਿ ਨ ਆਵੀ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਲੋਭ ਸੁਆਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: manamukhaa no parateet na aavee a(n)tar lobh suaau ||
lines.translation: The self-willed manmukhs have no faith; they are filled with greed and self-interest.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਸਬਦੁ ਨ ਭੇਦਿਓ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਨ ਲਾਗਾ ਭਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: guramukh hiradai sabad na bhedio har naam na laagaa bhaau ||
lines.translation: They are not Gurmukh - they do not understand the Word of the Shabad in their hearts; they do not love the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕੂੜ ਕਪਟ ਪਾਜੁ ਲਹਿ ਜਾਸੀ ਮਨਮੁਖ ਫੀਕਾ ਅਲਾਉ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: kooR kapat paaj lahi jaasee manamukh pheekaa alaau ||3||
lines.translation: Their masks of falsehood and hypocrisy shall fall off; the self-willed manmukhs speak with insipid words. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਭਗਤਾ ਵਿਚਿ ਆਪਿ ਵਰਤਦਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਜੀ ਭਗਤੀ ਹੂ ਤੂ ਜਾਤਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: bhagataa vich aap varatadaa prabh jee bhagatee hoo too jaataa ||
lines.translation: You are pervading through Your devotees, O Dear God; through Your devotees, You are known.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹ ਸਭ ਲੋਕ ਹੈ ਤੇਰੀ ਤੂ ਏਕੋ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਬਿਧਾਤਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: maaiaa moh sabh lok hai teree too eko purakh bidhaataa ||
lines.translation: All the people are enticed by Maya; they are Yours, Lord - You alone are the Architect of Destiny.
